description: For every arithmetic theory \(T\supseteq Q\), the specified sentence \(L_A\) satisfies \(T\vdash L_A\leftrightarrow(\Box L_A\to A)\), with no consistency assumption.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Lob.lob_equivalence (P : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula Unit)
  (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence)
  (T : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory)
  (hQ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.Q ⊆ T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T
    (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.iff (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Lob.lobSentence P A)
      (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.imp (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Lob.box P (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Lob.lobSentence P A))
        A))
